Meet Your Coach

Retired from the stage.
Never retired from the work.

I'm Johnny Forrester, a Clinical Nurse Specialist with an MSc and BSc, and a competitive bodybuilder on the IFBB Professional League and PCA Physical Culture Association stage. Fifteen years of clinical and competitive experience taught me the same lesson twice: you can't optimise what you don't measure.

The Anabolic Nurse brings that discipline to everyday coaching — training, nutrition and lifestyle programmes built around your own blood work, not generic templates. Whether you're chasing a physique goal or simply want to understand what's really going on inside your body, every plan starts with data.

Retired... but the passion will always be there.

Ways we work together

Every plan starts with data — then it's built entirely around you.

1:1 Personal Training

Structured, progressive training built around your results, your schedule and your goals.

Evidence-Based Nutrition

Practical, sustainable nutrition guidance — no fads, just an approach that fits your life and moves your markers.

Body Composition & Performance

Regular tracking of body composition and performance markers, so progress is measured, not guessed at.

Accountability & Mindset Coaching
